name: worktime-buddy
description: Dual-job time & income tracker with timezone buddy — PWA & Android App

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www', {recursive: true}); ['index.html', 'styles.css', 'app.js', 'manifest.json', 'sw.js'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/' + f)); console.log('Build complete');"
